text: What is the primary function of Cascading Style Sheets (CSS)?
choices: To structure the content of a web page
To specify styles for the visual elements of a website
To validate user input in forms
explanation: Cascading Style Sheets or CSS allows you to specify styles for the visual elements of the website. It separates content from presentation.

text: In the CSS syntax `H1 { color : green }`, what is `H1` referred to as?
explanation: The selector is the HTML element on which you want to apply the style. In the example, H1 is the selector.

text: Which menu option in KompoZer is used to ensure CSS is used by default?
explanation: To make sure that KompoZer uses CSS by default, click Edit -> Preferences. This will open the Options dialog box.

text: What are the two main parts of a CSS rule?
choices: A selector and one or more declarations
explanation: A CSS rule has two main parts: a selector, and one or more declarations.

text: Which button on the Composition Toolbar allows you to open the CSS Stylesheets dialog box?
explanation: In the composition toolbar, select the Cascade button. This will open the CSS Stylesheets dialog box.

text: In the CSS Stylesheets dialog, which tab is used to change the font family and size?
explanation: In the Text tab... select the options as per the style required... Font family section... Font size.

text: Which tab in the CSS dialog allows you to set an image as the background?
explanation: To set the background color, select the Background tab... If you want to keep an image in the background then in the Image option, click on 'Choose file'.

text: What does the 'Borders' tab in the CSS Stylesheets dialog allow you to configure?
explanation: To set the border, select the Border tab. This will open the options for the border... specify the width and the color of the border... style.

text: Which tab in the CSS dialog displays the generated CSS code?
explanation: Click on the General tab. This will show the CSS code which is generated as shown in figure 2.10.

text: JavaScript is primarily used in web pages for:
choices: Validating data on the client side
explanation: It is used to validate the data entered in the HTML forms on the client side before sending it to the server.

text: Which HTML tag is used to insert JavaScript code?
explanation: The <script> tag tells the browser to interpret all the text between the <script> tag as a script.

text: Is JavaScript a case-sensitive language?
explanation: Remember, JavaScript is a case sensitive language.

text: Where is it generally preferred to place the `<script>` tag in an HTML document?
explanation: But generally it is preferred that the code be placed in the <head> tag.

text: Which symbol is used to separate statements in JavaScript?
explanation: The semicolon is used as a mark of separation rather than termination.

text: Which built-in JavaScript function displays a message box to the user?
explanation: JavaScript provides some inbuilt functions such as alert(). The alert() function takes the text and displays it in an alert box.

text: Which keyword is used to define a function in JavaScript?
explanation: A function is defined by the keyword function and the block of code is written inside the curly braces.

text: What does the `return false` statement do in a form validation function?
choices: It stops the function from executing further and prevents submission
It returns a value to the server
explanation: This is possible by using the return statement. The use of return statement, will stop the function from executing... (returning false typically stops form submission).

text: Which event handler is typically used to trigger validation when a form is submitted?
explanation: So, we need to use the onsubmit() event handler. Therefore, in figure 2.18 we had added an event handler onsubmit().

text: What is the top-level object in the Browser Object Model (BOM)?
explanation: The top level object in the browser object model is Window object.

text: Which object represents the web page displayed in the browser?
explanation: The document object represents the web page displayed in the browser.

text: Which method is used to place the cursor in a specific form element?
explanation: The focus method is used to apply focus on a particular element of the form... the cursor will be placed inside the element.

text: Which JavaScript function checks if a value is Not-a-Number?
explanation: To work with numeric values, JavaScript uses built-in functions. One of most commonly used numeric function is isNaN().

text: In the script `var x = document.js1.name.value;`, what does `js1` refer to?
choices: The name of the input field
explanation: We have declared a variable named x... `document.js1.name.value`... Here, `js1` is the name of the form (as seen in Figure 2.16 'Form Name: js1').

text: What does the `isNaN(123)` function return?
explanation: isNaN(123) returns false as the value '123' is a number.

text: Which event occurs when a user clicks on a form element?
explanation: click: User clicks on a form element.

text: What is a variable in JavaScript?
explanation: A variable is a container for storing data. Remember, that the variables in JavaScript are also case sensitive.

text: In the CSS rule `H1 { color : green }`, what is `color`?
explanation: Declaration consists of a property associated with the HTML element... `color` is the property.

text: Which tab in the CSS Stylesheets dialog allows you to change the text alignment?
explanation: In the Text tab... Alignment menu....

text: What does the `action` attribute of a form specify?
choices: The URL where data is sent
explanation: The action attribute is used to specify where to send the form data... It takes a filename as value.

text: Which method is used to write content directly to the web page document?
explanation: Here write is a method which is a part of the document object... `document.write('HELLO STUDENTS')`.
